title: Big Eye Louis's animal imitations and Jimmy Palao on violin
summary: Barnes describes Louis imitating a rooster and mule on his C clarinet, and playing with violinist Jimmy Palao.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: That was in, or was, Italy. And Chicken Mille. Now that was one that was crazy about, he and Louis played that, you know. He used to make it so much different like a rooster cackling, a hen cackling, a rooster crud.
On his clarinet? Yeah, yeah, on his clarinet. Yeah.
On his clarinet. Yeah. Yeah. He'd be making that thing. Yeah, I'd like to have heard that. Well he's a pretty good man on different things like that. And a good old mule.
He used to have a habit of making a good old mule and the mule would holler. Oh yeah?

You know, would make that noise in the corner like he called for his breakfast or something. He's a little lightning tower. Louis, Louis, big old Louis. That's all I'm talking about. Yeah, I said heard that. Yeah.
And that was his C clarinet he was playing at that time.

C clarinet. Yeah. He'd do all that stuff on there. Do all that. I'm thinking Louis was a pretty good clarinet player when they come down for all of that and making different things. Oh he's wonderful. Now you take the other man that's playing clarinet they play and make all the things with the music, you know, like with the music go back a little bit and come in. But he go all around the music and come right back in there. You understand? Yeah. That part that was so good. Yeah. Louis was a good kid. Must have had a very good head for music. Oh yeah, the wonderful thing.

Now he'd play out the lake and they'd say, look he was playing over here, the Infiddle Band. Was playing over there. Oh let's go. I mean everything was coming. I don't care who it was, they was coming along in there. That's the time Jimmy Palau was playing violin with him. Violin player. Yeah. He was playing violin with him. How was he on that violin?
Palau. He was good. He was good.
